meta.title: SrednaBG — average speed for section control
meta.description: Free Android and Android Auto app that shows your running average speed inside Bulgaria's section-control zones. No ads, no account, no tracking.
hero.title: Always know your average speed.
hero.subtitle: SrednaBG computes your running average inside section-control zones in real time and tells you exactly how fast you can drive for the rest of the section.
features.headline: What SrednaBG does
features.feat_avg.title: Running average, live
features.feat_avg.body: The second you enter a zone, your running average becomes the hero number. No lag, no jitter — it updates once a second.
features.feat_max.title: Max now — the only tool that shows it
features.feat_max.body: "Max now" is the top speed you can drive for the rest of the zone without breaking the limit. Waze shows the zone — SrednaBG tells you what to do.
features.feat_status.title: Green, amber, red — at a glance
features.feat_status.body: The screen color matches your state. Green — within limit. Amber — careful, slow down. Red — you're already over.
features.feat_voice.title: Voice alerts in Bulgarian and English
features.feat_voice.body: Keep your eyes on the road. SrednaBG speaks zone entries, exits, and slowdown warnings in the language you pick.
features.feat_offline.title: Works fully offline
features.feat_offline.body: The Bulgaria map and zone list are bundled inside the app. No internet needed in the car. Updates arrive quietly when you're on Wi-Fi.
features.feat_dual.title: Alongside Waze, or instead of it
features.feat_dual.body: Run SrednaBG as a full navigator on Android Auto, or let it sit quietly behind Waze / Google Maps — you'll hear its voice when it matters.
how.headline: How it works
how.step1: Open the app. It watches for zones in the background.
how.step2: Entered a zone. The running average is the hero number.
how.step3: Over the limit? "Max now" tells you how slow to drive to recover.

privacy.headline: What we don't do
priv.no_cookies: No cookies on this site. No trackers anywhere.
priv.no_account: No account, no email, no signup. Install and drive.
priv.no_ads: No ads. No in-app purchases. Free forever.
priv.no_sdk: No third-party SDKs. No Google Analytics. No Firebase.
priv.no_cloud: Your location never leaves your phone.
